ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Provides the rising-edge clock that times register updates; it sequences all clocked processes which update bus response, control fields, counter, hw reset flags and reset_cause.
role: times bus access and counter logic
ports.evidence: rising_edge(clk_i) used as clock in processes bus_access, wdt_counter, reset_generator, reset_identifier

ports.name: rstn_ext_i
ports.functionality: Acts as the asynchronous reset input for the reset_cause register; when low it clears reset_cause to "00" in the reset_identifier process.
ports.evidence: if (rstn_ext_i = '0') then reset_cause <= "00" in process reset_identifier

ports.name: rstn_dbg_i
ports.functionality: When asserted low inside the reset_identifier clocked process it causes reset_cause to be set to "01" on the next rising edge, governing reset_cause updates.
ports.evidence: if (rstn_dbg_i = '0') then reset_cause <= "01" in process reset_identifier (rising_edge(clk_i) branch)

ports.name: rstn_sys_i
ports.functionality: Acts as the global asynchronous reset in multiple clocked processes; when low it initializes bus response, control fields, counter and hardware reset flags in their reset branches.
ports.evidence: if (rstn_sys_i = '0') then ... in processes bus_access, wdt_counter, reset_generator

ports.name: bus_req_i
ports.functionality: Supplies bus strobe, read/write, address and data used to generate bus responses, to write control fields or compare the reset password, and to gate which bus-access branches execute.
ports.evidence: bus_req_i fields used in process bus_access (if bus_req_i.stb = '1', bus_req_i.rw, bus_req_i.addr(2), bus_req_i.data ...)

ports.name: bus_req_i.addr
ports.functionality: Provides the address bits used by bus_access (bit 2 selects control register vs reset password path); its bit(2) gates whether writes target control fields or password path.
ports.evidence: if (bus_req_i.addr(2) = '0') then ... else ... in process bus_access

ports.name: bus_req_i.data
ports.functionality: Carries write bits used to update ctrl fields and carries the candidate password for reset; its bit-slices source ctrl.enable/lock/strict/timeout and its equality comparison governs reset_wdt/reset_force.
ports.evidence: bus_req_i.data(...) used in assignments inside bus_access (writes to ctrl fields and comparison to reset_pwd_c)

ports.name: bus_req_i.ben
ports.functionality: Declared as part of the bus request record but not referenced anywhere in this source; no behavior derives from it here.

ports.name: bus_req_i.stb
ports.functionality: Provides the strobe that starts bus_access handling; it drives bus_rsp_o.ack and gates whether read or write handling occurs.
ports.evidence: bus_rsp_o.ack <= bus_req_i.stb; if (bus_req_i.stb = '1') then ... in process bus_access

ports.name: bus_req_i.rw
ports.functionality: Selects read versus write behavior in bus_access; when '1' it enables write paths to ctrl fields or password handling, otherwise it enables readback of control/status into bus_rsp_o.data.
ports.evidence: if (bus_req_i.rw = '1') then ... else ... in process bus_access

ports.name: bus_req_i.src
ports.functionality: Declared but not referenced in this source; it plays no role here.

ports.name: bus_req_i.priv
ports.functionality: Declared in the request record but not used in this design unit.

ports.name: bus_req_i.debug
ports.functionality: Part of the bus request record but not referenced in this source.

ports.name: bus_req_i.amo
ports.functionality: Declared but not used in this file.

ports.name: bus_req_i.amoop
ports.functionality: Present in the request record but not referenced here.

ports.name: bus_req_i.lock
ports.functionality: Declared in the bus request record but not used inside this entity.

ports.name: bus_req_i.fence
ports.functionality: Part of the bus request record but unused in this source.

ports.name: bus_rsp_o
ports.functionality: Collects response fields driven by bus_access process and exports them to the bus; its subfields report ack, err and data derived from bus_req_i and internal control/status registers.
ports.evidence: bus_rsp_o fields assigned in process bus_access (reset assignment and per-clock rising_edge(clk_i) assignments)

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.ack
ports.functionality: Reports the bus request strobe as an acknowledge; each clock cycle it is driven to the current bus_req_i.stb value inside the bus_access process and exported.

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.err
ports.functionality: Is driven to '0' in the bus_access process every clock; it is exported but not driven from any internal variable in this source.

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.data
ports.functionality: Carries readback of control and status to the bus; specific bits are assigned from ctrl.enable/lock/strict/timeout and reset_cause inside the clocked bus_access process, and otherwise zeroed.
ports.evidence: bus_rsp_o.data(...) <= ... assignments inside bus_access (rising_edge(clk_i)), and default (others => '0')

ports.name: clkgen_en_o
ports.functionality: Continuously reports ctrl.enable to the clock generator; it is driven combinationally from the internal ctrl.enable register and exported.

ports.name: clkgen_i
ports.functionality: Provides prescaler tick bits; a single indexed bit (clk_div4096_c) is selected to produce prsc_tick which feeds the counter and reset logic.

ports.name: rstn_o
ports.functionality: Exports the synthesized reset value as the logical inverse of hw_rst_timeout or hw_rst_access; it is driven combinationally from those internal signals.

signals.name: ctrl
signals.functionality: Holds watchdog configuration fields (enable, lock, strict, timeout) as registers; its fields are updated by bus_access writes and reset to zeros on rstn_sys_i.
role: source for watchdog and bus readback
signals.evidence: ctrl.* assigned in process bus_access (reset and rising_edge(clk_i) write branches)

signals.name: ctrl.enable
signals.functionality: Register bit that enables the watchdog; written from bus_req_i.data(ctrl_enable_c) when unlocked and read by clkgen_en_o and counter start/clear logic.
signals.evidence: ctrl.enable <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_enable_c) in bus_access; used in prsc and reset logic (cnt_started, hw_rst_* calculations)

signals.name: ctrl.lock
signals.functionality: Holds the lock state written from bus_req_i.data(ctrl_lock_c) AND the new ctrl.enable; when set, further writes to control registers cause reset_force instead of updates.
role: governs whether writes update ctrl or force reset
signals.evidence: ctrl.lock <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_lock_c) and ctrl.enable in bus_access; checked (if ctrl.lock = '0') to allow writes

signals.name: ctrl.strict
signals.functionality: Register bit written from bus_req_i.data(ctrl_strict_c); combined with ctrl.enable and reset_force to generate hw_rst_access in reset_generator.
signals.evidence: ctrl.strict <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_strict_c) in process bus_access; used in hw_rst_access <= ctrl.enable and ctrl.strict and reset_force

signals.name: ctrl.timeout
signals.functionality: 24-bit register loaded from bus_req_i.data(31 downto 8) on writes; compared against the counter to assert cnt_timeout and read back into bus_rsp_o.data(31 downto 8).
role: compares with counter to detect timeout
signals.evidence: ctrl.timeout <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_timeout_msb_c downto ctrl_timeout_lsb_c) in bus_access; used in cnt_timeout and bus_rsp_o.data assignments

signals.name: prsc_tick
signals.functionality: Combinational single-bit tick derived from clkgen_i indexed bit; it feeds counter increment logic and contributes to hw reset-on-timeout generation.
role: sources counter increment and hw reset timing
signals.evidence: prsc_tick <= clkgen_i(clk_div4096_c); used in cnt_inc <= prsc_tick and cnt_started <= ... and hw_rst_timeout <= ... in clocked processes

signals.name: cnt
signals.functionality: 24-bit register incremented when cnt_inc is '1'; resets to zero when ctrl.enable='0' or reset_wdt asserted. It is also compared to ctrl.timeout to produce cnt_timeout.
signals.evidence: cnt <= std_ulogic_vector(unsigned(cnt) + 1) when cnt_inc = '1' in process wdt_counter; reset when ctrl.enable='0' or reset_wdt='1'

signals.name: cnt_started
signals.functionality: Register that records whether counting has started; it is set when ctrl.enable and prsc_tick occur and gates counter increment via cnt_inc.
signals.evidence: cnt_started <= ctrl.enable and (cnt_started or prsc_tick) in process wdt_counter

signals.name: cnt_inc
signals.functionality: Register set each clock to prsc_tick AND cnt_started; it gates whether the counter increments on the following clock cycle and thus governs cnt updates.
signals.evidence: cnt_inc <= prsc_tick and cnt_started in process wdt_counter; used in cnt update branch

signals.name: cnt_timeout
signals.functionality: Combinational flag asserted when counting started and cnt equals ctrl.timeout; it feeds reset_generator to help generate a hardware reset on timeout.
signals.evidence: cnt_timeout <= '1' when (cnt_started = '1') and (cnt = ctrl.timeout) else '0'; used in reset_generator

signals.name: reset_cause
signals.functionality: 2-bit register recording the reason for the last reset; updated in reset_identifier based on rstn_dbg_i, hw_rst_timeout, hw_rst_access and cleared by rstn_ext_i.
signals.evidence: reset_cause assigned in process reset_identifier (reset branch and rising_edge(clk_i) branches using rstn_dbg_i, hw_rst_timeout, hw_rst_access); read into bus_rsp_o.data in bus_access

signals.name: hw_rst_timeout
signals.functionality: Register set when ctrl.enable, cnt_timeout and prsc_tick coincide (in reset_generator); it participates in creating rstn_o and in updating reset_cause.
signals.evidence: hw_rst_timeout <= ctrl.enable and cnt_timeout and prsc_tick in process reset_generator; used in reset_identifier and rstn_o

signals.name: hw_rst_access
signals.functionality: Register asserted when ctrl.enable and ctrl.strict and reset_force are true (in reset_generator); it drives rstn_o low and is recorded in reset_cause.
signals.evidence: hw_rst_access <= ctrl.enable and ctrl.strict and reset_force in process reset_generator; used in reset_identifier and rstn_o

signals.name: reset_wdt
signals.functionality: Register set by a correct password write (bus_access) to clear the watchdog; it resets cnt when asserted and is cleared each cycle, controlled by bus writes.
signals.evidence: reset_wdt <= '1' when bus_req_i.data(31 downto 0) = reset_pwd_c in bus_access; used in wdt_counter to clear cnt

signals.name: reset_force
signals.functionality: Register asserted on illegal bus accesses or writes when control is locked; it is set in bus_access and used (with ctrl.strict and ctrl.enable) to generate hw_rst_access.
signals.evidence: reset_force set to '1' in bus_access on illegal writes/locked writes; used in hw_rst_access <= ctrl.enable and ctrl.strict and reset_force
